Title: A Benchmark for Audio Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models
Author: Iwona Christop, Mateusz Czyżnikiewicz, Paweł Skórzewski, Łukasz Bondaruk, Jakub Kubiak, Marcin Lewandowski, Marek Kubis
Description: ART (Audio Reasoning Tasks) is a benchmark for assessing the ability of multimodal models to solve problems that require reasoning over audio signal.
